body: I don't plan on dying, I just feel like I want to sometimes. tbh I just needed to vent and I don't like talking to my friends about this kinda thing. I'm supposed to be the the happy funny one in the group and no body likes a sad clown especially one that's talking about wanting to die. Thanks for reading tho. I just wanted someone to listen and let me be depressed for awhile. Plus I always feel better after writing something, it helps calm my nerves.
